title: ecb-2: fix wp11_piv_sign TLV parser to use ber_len_decode
description: Replace the single i++ skip of the 7C length with a call to ber_len_decode. Then decode the inner 82 length the same way. This makes RSA-2048 PIV responses work (which use 3-byte 0x82 0x01 0x00 length encoding). Add defensive bounds checks at every step: tag present, length decoded, content within buffer.
